texts.source_text: How to be a Good Son or Daughter? - Part 1
texts.content_exam: It's not always easy to be a good son. Sometimes, you make a mistake and can't find a way to fix it. Other times, you disagree with your parents and don't know how to talk to them without starting a fight. What shall you do? Show your love. Tell your parents what's going on in your life. Your parents love you and want to know what's going on in your life. They need to know all of the daily details, but they would love to know what's on your mind, from your struggles with your studies to any big problems you're having with your friends. They really do care, and even if they can't always help, they would just like to know what's happening. Don't be afraid to ask for their advice. Believe it or not, your parents were once your age, and they've gone through the same struggles that you're going through. They'll appreciate that you value their opinion.

questions.question: ......................... is the first advice given to be a good son/daughter.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: Show your love

questions.question: Parents would love to know ......................... .
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: what's on your mind

questions.question: You should tell your parents what's on your mind because ......................... .
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: they love you and care

questions.question: Parents really care about ......................... .
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: your struggles and problems

questions.question: If you make a mistake, you should ......................... .
options: find a way to fix it
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: find a way to fix it

texts.source_text: How to be a Good Son or Daughter? - Part 2
texts.content_exam: Be kind to your siblings. It's sometimes difficult to get along with your siblings, whether they are older or younger, but you should try to develop relationships with them. You can help your siblings do their schoolwork, or clean up. This will not only help you be a good example to your siblings, but it will also help your parents. Do as well in school as you can. Your parents will be happy if you respect your teachers, do your homework, and keep your grades up to the best of your ability. If you need help in school, ask your teachers or your parents for help. This will put you on a path to succeed in your future, and it will also make life much easier for your parents. At the end of the day, the thing that will please your parents the most is to see their son/daughter growing into a happy, responsible adult.

questions.question: It is sometimes difficult to get along with your siblings.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: True

questions.question: You should not ask for help in school.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: False (You should ask your teachers or parents for help).

questions.question: Being kind to your siblings helps your parents.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: True

questions.question: How can you be a good example to your siblings?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: By helping them with their schoolwork or cleaning up.

questions.question: What should you do at school to be a good student?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: Respect your teachers, do your homework, and keep your grades up.

texts.content_exam: Most people are curious about different countries and their cultures. So, some tend to make friends from all around the world. Making friends from all over the world is easy nowadays. We only have to sign up to a pen pal website under the supervision of parents. When we create a profile, we will be asked to fill out basic details about ourselves; like our interests, the country we are from, and our birth date. We will be able to have conversations with new friends in different countries, so learning another language can help us build bonds with people that speak foreign languages. We must be polite when asking them about their lives and things that they are interested in. Being a nice person and willing to learn about new experiences will help you make friends wherever you go.

questions.question: Most people are curious about ......................... .
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: different countries and cultures

questions.question: We can make friends from all over the world by ......................... .
options: signing up to a pen pal website
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: signing up to a pen pal website

questions.question: When we create a profile, we fill out ......................... .
options: our interests, country, and birth date
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: our interests, country, and birth date

questions.question: Learning a foreign language helps us ......................... .
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: build bonds with people

questions.question: We need to sign up to ......................... .
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: a pen pal website

texts.content_exam: We will be able to have conversations with new friends in different countries, so learning another language can help us build bonds with people that speak foreign languages. We must be polite when asking them about their lives and things that they are interested in. Being a nice person and willing to learn about new experiences will help you make friends wherever you go. If we have the chance to travel one day, we may meet these friends face to face. We have to keep in mind that different people in different countries have different cultures and different life styles which enrich our knowledge about various topics. We have to respect other people's privacy and try to learn the best from them.

questions.question: Being polite is not important when making friends.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: False (We must be polite).

questions.question: Different countries have different cultures.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: True

questions.question: We should not respect other people's privacy.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: False (We have to respect privacy).

questions.question: What helps us to make friends wherever we go?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: Being a nice person and willing to learn about new experiences.

questions.question: What should we keep in mind about people in different countries?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: They have different cultures and life styles which enrich our knowledge.
